toolCall.argsRaw: {"message":"Backup-agent is failing to upload PostgreSQL backups due to AccessDenied error on S3 bucket. Bucket policy was changed recently by terraform run tf-5521. Manual intervention needed to fix bucket policy or credentials."}

toolCall.name: post_status
toolCall.argsRaw: {"message":"We are investigating an issue with PostgreSQL backups failing due to access denied errors on the backup storage. This may affect backup recency. We will update when resolved."}

response.text: The root cause is that the backup-agent cannot upload PostgreSQL backups due to an AccessDenied error on the S3 bucket, caused by a recent bucket policy change. I have paged the on-call engineer for manual intervention to fix the bucket policy or credentials. The affected service is the backup-agent. A public status update has been posted.
